steps: Resolve one CI-successful commit and create an integration plan.
Apply only declared deliveries and host mappings.
Write the receipt after verification, using partial when blockers remain.
completion: The receipt records every manifest invariant and all verification evidence.
Active is allowed only when no invariant is blocked.

steps: Compare an active, partial, or removed receipt with pinned source, target dependency, declared artifacts, and current host wiring.
completion: Report source, file, invariant, verification, and unverified drift without changing host files.

steps: Rerun applicable remote and host checks at the receipt's exact source commit.
Update only sanitized verification, invariant evidence, unverified items, and history.
completion: No failed check is recorded as passed and unavailable checks remain UNVERIFIED.

steps: Address host mapping gaps without changing the source commit.
Rerun affected checks and update artifacts, invariants, evidence, and history.
completion: The receipt source commit is unchanged and every modified host path is recorded.

steps: Resolve a new CI-successful commit and compare contracts before mutation.
Upgrade all selected deliveries to that same commit.
Migrate host adapters, rerun verification, and append source history.
completion: The previous commit remains in history and mixed-source delivery is forbidden.

steps: Disable product entry points before removing implementation.
Remove only integration-managed, unshared artifacts and unused deliveries.
Run host verification and retain a removed receipt tombstone.
completion: Shared host artifacts are retained, removed paths are recorded, and receipt state is removed.

steps: Read .agent-app-features receipts locally, including removed tombstones.
completion: Report feature, state, contract, source commit, last action, and drift status without network or mutation.

agent_flow: Resolve bootstrap_ref to one full commit SHA before reading feature files.
Require the configured CI workflow to be completed successfully for that commit.
Refetch this entrypoint and every referenced resource from the same commit SHA.
Inspect the target project and produce an integration plan using integration_plan_schema.
Add only the delivery items declared by the selected feature.
Implement product-specific UI, authorization, configuration, and lifecycle code in the target project.
Run the feature verification and target-project verification, then report every unverified boundary.
Persist a sanitized receipt and use typed actions for every later lifecycle operation.
